description: This file defines the ContentFragment class, an Android Fragment responsible for displaying and managing content within a gallery app. It handles UI initialization, drag-and-drop events, action modes for contextual actions, content updates, and sharing photos.

classes.name: ContentFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that displays images, handles user interactions such as drag-and-drop, selection, and sharing functionality.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's UI, sets up event listeners for drag, click, and long-press actions.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Performs additional setup after activity creation, restores state, and updates action bar and UI visibility.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, primarily for navigation.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current state such as position, category, and UI visibility.

methods.name: setSystemUiVisible
methods.description: Toggles visibility of system UI elements and action bar.

methods.name: processDragStarted
methods.description: Determines if a drag event should be accepted based on MIME type.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Handles drop events, parses data, updates content, and modifies list selection.

methods.name: updateContentAndRecycleBitmap
methods.description: Updates displayed image content and manages bitmap resource cleanup.

methods.name: shareCurrentPhoto
methods.description: Compresses the current image and initiates a share intent using an AsyncTask.
